title: Workable posting row
description: One open posting from a public Workable board, read from the board's own JSON.

status.title: Status
status.description: DELIVERED, NOT_CHECKED_BOARD_NOT_FOUND, NOT_CHECKED_BOARD_EMPTY, NOT_CHECKED_ERROR or INVALID_INPUT.

board.title: Board identifier
board.description: Workable subdomain, as used in apply.workable.com/<board>.

department.title: Department
department.description: Department as published by the employer.

function.title: Function
function.description: Function as published by the employer.

industry.title: Industry
industry.description: Industry as published by the employer.

education.title: Education
education.description: Education requirement as published, null when the employer left it empty.

remote.title: Remote
remote.description: True when the board itself flags the posting as remote.

locations.title: All locations
locations.description: Every location of the posting, not only the primary one. Each entry has country, countryCode, city, region.

publishedOn.title: Published on
publishedOn.description: Date the board reports as publication date (YYYY-MM-DD).

createdAt.title: Created at
createdAt.description: Date the posting was created in Workable (YYYY-MM-DD).

applyUrl.title: Apply URL
applyUrl.description: Application URL as published by the board.

description.title: Description
description.description: Posting description when includeDetails is on; html or plain text depending on descriptionFormat.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Human readable reason for a NOT_CHECKED_* or INVALID_INPUT row.

billable.title: Billable
billable.description: True only for rows the run charges for.
